Home.eyebrow: Once a week · not a to-do list
Home.title: A gentle weekly review, like a postcard to yourself.
Home.lead: Soft Boring Weekly is a quiet check-in. Sit down once, answer six small questions, and save how the week felt. No streaks, no dashboards, no chores — just a soft place to notice.
Home.sampleHeading: This is what a week looks like.
Home.sampleLead: New here? Read a completed review first. Then write yours — yours starts blank.
Home.sampleIntro: Demo content — a cozy, ordinary week, already answered.
Home.sampleCtaHint: Same six questions. Your page starts empty.

sampleAnswers.energy: A slow Saturday walk after the rain. The air smelled like wet leaves, and I didn't rush anywhere.
sampleAnswers.drain: Three meetings that could have been a note. I came home tired in a way that tea couldn't fix.
sampleAnswers.lessOf: Checking messages before I even sat down. The week felt like it started already behind.
sampleAnswers.priorities: Finish the kitchen shelf. Call my sister. Leave one evening empty on purpose.
sampleAnswers.feeling: Lighter than last week. Still a little tired, but the walk helped.
sampleAnswers.summary: A slightly messy week that still had a few quiet corners.

Home.ideaOneBody: Not every morning. Not a daily habit tracker. Just a few unhurried minutes, once a week.
Home.ideaTwoBody: Energy, drain, less of, three priorities, a feeling, one sentence. That's the whole page.
Home.ideaThreeBody: Come back when you want to remember. History stays quiet until you open it.
Home.pricingFree: Free: write every week, and keep the latest four reviews open.
Home.pricingPaid: Soft+ keeps unlimited history, a small feeling chart, and Soft Wall.
Home.bottomTitle: Your week can have a quiet corner too.
Home.bottomBody: No setup required. Write as a guest, or create an account so history follows you.
